ruleDefinitions.name: New Firewall Rule Added In Windows Firewall Exception List For Potential Suspicious Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the addition of a new rule to the Windows Firewall exception list for an application located in a potentially suspicious location. Note: Unmapped fields: ApplicationPath, Action

sequences.query: ((event_id = 2004 OR event_id = 2071 OR event_id = 2097) AND (ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Tmp\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*"))) AND  NOT (Action = 2)
